company.name: Flowspace
company.description:
Flowspace is a modern fulfillment provider that combines powerful technology with expert fulfillment operations to deliver seamless and scalable execution that moves with your business.

Purpose-built for ecommerce and omnichannel fulfillment, Flowspace unifies order management (OMS), inventory management (IMS), network optimization, seamless integrations, EDI, and proprietary warehouse management (WMS) technology. With negotiated carrier rates, automated B2B packing, D2C kitting and bundling, and a self-service AI tool, Flowspace provides the flexibility and control modern brands need to operate efficiently at scale without adding operational headcount.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $31,000,000, or 66.64% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,390,029 to $147,738,639, a 61.81x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 76 (-4 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
